description: ⭐ DEAN'S DAIRY EXPERIMENT (12/09/2026), arm paid. Build, then immediately GROW the building just built, PAYING a matching activation card as normal. The stack advances, so the clog brake survives and a Tier 3 at threshold 1 jams the instant it is grown. This is a TEMPO rule and not a price cut: nothing about the cost curve moves. ⛔ C100 IS OPEN AND THIS IS AN ARM ON TOP OF AN ARM: the shipped default is still visitCurrency 'commons'. The control is overlays/notice-board-visit-host-draw-by-seats-v1.overlay.json and every one of its twenty passengers is pinned here by name. ⛔ 30 of the 90 deck cards (every Power, every Endgame) have NO threshold and NO activation type, so this clause is DEAD on a third of the deck by construction, which is what stops the Dairy board becoming the cheap route to the Power layer. ⚠️ You may never visit your own board, so a stronger Dairy board is a gift to Dairy's RIVALS; what Dairy gets is traffic, and traffic is fee cards to harvest. ⛔ MAY NOT BE QUOTED: the bonus rate is a share of TURNS and never plays per turn; no level is comparable with a reference-v14 or earlier number; the barn glut reads per-seat, never the pooled median. ⛔ PASSENGERS PINNED 12/09/2026: Dean's plain-action balloon and Village Store ruling moved sixteen shipped leaves at once. This overlay predates that flip and every report taken against it does too, so each of those leaves is pinned here BY NAME at its PRE-FLIP value. Without it an arm read as a delta against a pre-flip base would silently gain a one-card flight, an always-present Aerodrome and a live coin economy. That is the 05/09/2026 passenger lesson: an overlay that should not move with the shipped default has to pin every knob the flip moved.
